badges.line: You live on both sides of this one. Which side shows up depends on the moment.

halves.name: Straight Shooter
halves.desc: You say what you mean and you like things done properly. The classic way makes sense to you, and the final call on your life stays with you.

axes.line: You love hard and keep your own door. Close still means space.
You say the hard thing to their face, because that's how you show respect.
Traditions, rituals and the way a home should run feel like home to you.

halves.name: Creature of Habit
halves.desc: Your days run on routine and order, and you're in no rush to prove anything to anyone. Same café, same walk, same excellent choice.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.
A fair process keeps everyone safe. A rule is a rule.

stings: The truth comes out of you easily. Telling someone you need them takes a lot longer.
Your life is so steady that some nights you wonder what the other version would have looked like.
hearts: Plain words are how I show respect.
I chose my ordinary days. I didn't settle for them.

tags.name: Classic at heart
tags.heart: I can hold new ideas and old wishes at the same time.
tags.sting: You're open-minded about everyone's setup, and a small part of you still wants the one you grew up with.

youToldGenii.said: A dish you make exactly the way your family does
Do my half the way I was raised. Their half, their call.
Love it for them. Mine will run the way I grew up.

tags.name: No wedding needed
tags.heart: My love doesn't need a certificate.
tags.sting: You're not against weddings. You just get tired of being asked when.

youToldGenii.said: Never needed one. The dog is our marriage certificate.
Doing open-bar math. That's a whole used car.

tags.name: Family gets a vote
tags.heart: My family is part of my 'we', and I like it that way.
tags.sting: Big decisions feel safer with a family nod, and waiting for it can slow a few of them down.

youToldGenii.said: Sent a sibling or an aunt in first to soften them up.
A family group chat you actually reply in
Deal. Free help and home-cooked dinners nearby.

tags.name: Saves first, spends later
tags.heart: Being ready is how I relax.
tags.sting: You've saved for a rainy day so long that the sunny days sometimes go unspent.

youToldGenii.said: Money set aside that you pretend doesn't exist
Straight into savings. Future me says thanks.
Grow it with what it earns. Savings stay put.

tags.name: Texts back eventually
tags.heart: Missing you doesn't need a daily check-in.
tags.sting: Long silences feel normal to you. The person on the other end might be wondering where you went.

youToldGenii.said: Forgot about it. They'd answer eventually.
50+ unread texts, and you feel fine
Send a random pic, no hello. Like we never stopped.

calls.line: You still make the family recipe exactly as written.
Your idea of a proposal is 'wanna keep doing this?'
Your family knows your plans before your friends do.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘They get a play-by-play of my day. Photos of lunch included.’ Last time, you did: ‘Split up at the door. Met at the end to swap gossip.’

said.text: They get a play-by-play of my day. Photos of lunch included.

did.text: Split up at the door. Met at the end to swap gossip.
